# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is described as a big, fat, stolid youth. He has a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts, laughter, and chatter. He is extremely shy, needing his sister to propose to a woman on his behalf. Despite his shyness, he is capable of being puffed up and beaming with pride and happiness when driving or appearing with his wife.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

## Traits

- stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- shy  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
- lack of conversational gifts  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- to marry Anne Shirley  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews lived in Avonlea and drove a double-seated buggy, taking guests like Anne Shirley and Diana Barry to a concert at White Sands. Immensely admiring Anne, he insisted that she sit next to him on the front seat during the drive. Later, after his father gave him the upper farm in his own name, Billy wished to marry Anne but was too shy to ask her directly. He persuaded his sister Jane to propose to Anne on his behalf. Following Anne's rejection, he did not break his heart and instead married Nettie Blewett. The couple made their first official appearance at church together to the pride and pleasure of the Andrews family.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
